initial_decision: Preserve all metadata and runtime files. Do not treat sampled scenes, similar titles, other-edit indices or an arc-wide offset as full coverage. No build/test rerun or preview publication for unchanged code.

supplied_reference_followup.scope: Supplied sources A/B/C, existing exact-file observations and one representative edit. No unrestricted web search or other-video inspection.

source_a.finding: 25 Wano metadata entries exist for 71-95, with titles and runtimes but no original-anime coverage field. All 25 descriptions are empty. These titles are not the repository editorial scene labels.
source_a.provenance_finding: enrich_extra_meta describes the extra metadata catalogues as hand-maintained and enriches runtime/rating; it does not document a creator-authorized Muhn-to-Onigashima boundary conversion.
source_a.edit_71_stream_qualification: Listed size equals the Pixeldrain file size, which supports association but is not a cryptographic media match. Torrent infoHash and filename CRC are not the Pixeldrain SHA-256. The 1014-1015 filename tag matches the spreadsheet manga chapter field, not its anime episode field.

source_b.finding: The supplied 25 candidates exactly reproduce Onigashima 29-48 and End of Wano 01, 02, 03, 03.5, 04. The sheet maps its own releases; it supplies no Muhn file IDs, hashes or equivalence statement.
source_b.handover: Its watch guide transitions from One Pace Wano 62 to Onigashima 29. This is viewing order, not Muhn boundary evidence.

source_c.title: Anarchy in the BM (Big Mom)
source_c.finding: The official page lists 62 released Wano edits and says 63 onward are unreleased, with anime 1034-1085 as the remaining viewing alternative. This confirms the One Pace/Onigashima handover context, not Muhn 71-95 ranges.

edit_71_discrepancy.confidence: Moderate for story correspondence; insufficient for complete original-anime coverage.
edit_71_discrepancy.rejected_alternative: 1042-1044 is not established by the Robin editorial title or sparse memories/crew imagery; do not substitute it.
edit_71_discrepancy.existing_evidence: The 180s committed thumbnail shows Robin aboard the Sunny. The existing record also describes a tearful Robin sample. Neither observation uniquely identifies an original episode or the complete edit.
edit_71_discrepancy.duration_qualification: The 26-second difference precludes assuming an identical timed edit. It does not itself prove different original-anime episode boundaries.
edit_71_discrepancy.scene_reference_access: Indexed search excerpts were available. Full official episode pages returned HTTP 403; the wiki full-page fetch failed. No full-page access is claimed.
edit_71_discrepancy.scene_reference_finding: Episode 1036 synopsis places Momonosuke broadcasting through a Mary in this story period; the official 1037 excerpt continues the frog-Mary announcement. The endpoint therefore supports the proposed story period but does not uniquely establish 1036 versus reused/continued 1037 footage. The official 1043 excerpt describes Brook/Robin resisting Black Maria illusions, not a match to these newly inspected endpoints.
edit_71_discrepancy.full_range_limit: No complete source-to-edit comparison or creator-authored original-anime mapping is available. Opening/middle/end stills cannot enumerate all episodes used, detect every intercut/flashback, or establish exact boundaries.

budget.method: HTTP input seeks with ffmpeg, one 640px still per seek, 35-second command timeout. No full-video file saved, no bulk extraction, no repeat of previously recorded 180/360/900s samples.
budget.stop_reason: Partial correspondence for the representative edit does not supply a reliable full-range conversion. Further sparse sampling of 24 files would not resolve that missing evidence.
